messages:
irene: FYI — user @maria clicked a 'Verify Subscription' link in a support-looking email and forwarded headers + screenshot. Link hostname shows verify-subscribe[.]com. User reports they typed their password. Can we triage? /cc @samir
sec-bot: New phishing_report created: PR-2026-0401 by irene. Queue=P1.
samir: On it. Maria — did you force a reset or see any suspicious sessions?
maria: Forced password reset and revoked tokens via console already. No unusual sessions in the last 24h besides her own. She did enter the password.
alex: I'll pull headers and run the URL through sandbox + static checks. Posting initial curl to follow redirects.
alex: ```bash
curl -I 'http://verify-subscribe.com/login?utm=4f9c' -L -s
```
ops-bot: URL sandbox verdict: MALICIOUS — credential_phish. Domain performs 302 -> 2s redirect -> form post to third-party collector. Extracted artifact SHA256: abc123def456... (truncated).
samir: IOC: block verify-subscribe[.]com at perimeter and add to email gateway denylist. Also flag SPF/DKIM failures as a signal.
irene: Headers show SPF=fail, DKIM=none, From header displays support@subscribeservice.co. Recommend contacting ESP for takedown and adding blocklist.
alex: I extracted the form action: https://forms.submit-now[.]net/collect. No binary payload in sandbox — behavior is form POST capturing credentials. Looks like typical credential harvesting.
samir: Containment checklist (doing now): 1) Block domain at perimeter + proxy 2) Update email-gateway signatures 3) Force password reset for affected account (done) 4) Enforce MFA for org or impacted users. Maria — is the user on MFA?
maria: She wasn't. I enforced org-wide MFA for new sessions and kicked active sessions. Sending re-enroll email to the user.
irene: :eyes: Also want an org awareness note for the team and a quick KB entry for People Ops. Recommend adding detection rule: SPF fail + no DKIM + subject regex like /(verify|subscription|billing)/i.
alex: I'll open a detection rule PR in eng-security/signatures. Draft snippet below.
alex: ```yaml
name: phishing_verify_subscription
match_headers: 
  - spf: fail
  - dkim: absent
subject_regex: '(verify|subscription|billing)'
actions:
  - tag: suspect_phish
  - quarantine: true
```
sec-bot: Assigned: @alex -> detection rule, @samir -> takedown & intel sharing.
samir: Quick intel note: domain clusters with 'TridentGate' phishing observed late-2025. Will tag IoCs and share with FS-ISAC and our partners.
irene: After-action items: 1) KB for People Ops / comms draft 2) short lightning training for affected teams 3) add to post-incident log. Who can draft the user-facing comms?
maria: I can draft the user-facing email (no PII). Will target the affected team first and then org-wide awareness if more hits occur. Aim to send within 2 hours.
alex: PR created: https://git.company/eng-security/signatures/pulls/42 (includes rule + test cases).
sec-bot: PR merged and detection rule deployed to canary mailers. Monitoring active.
samir: Monitoring in place for 48h. Threshold: if >5 similar messages hit the filters, escalate to full incident response. For now marking triage as complete; will add summary to post-incident doc.
irene: Thanks everyone. Please update the PR and KB with any changes. I'll ping once takedown confirmation from ESP arrives. :thumbsup:
